prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Gyeongju — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Gyeongju as her world knows it — a golden capital of an eastern myth-world in a basin of low green hills: pale granite and dark pine wood, red-lacquered pillars under gently upswept dark-tiled eaves, thin hammered gold hung with trembling gold spangles, curved green jade, silk and lacquered wood, lantern-light and drifting spirit lights, cherry blossoms with softly glowing petals. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, the star tower, the great grass mounds or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a moonlit forest glade carpeted with softly glowing mushrooms and flowers, two moons above the trees
Season: autumn — clear, mild days, the low hills turning red and gold, and the October festival of the ancient capital with folk games, music and dance.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Hair: her hair gathered into a loose low ponytail over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.
Small moment: flower petals drift upward around her instead of falling.
Outfit: a sporty one-piece swimsuit with a racerback and a high neckline — in one bright, saturated colour such as cherry red, cobalt blue, sunflower yellow or kelly green; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with a sheer button-up shirt worn open over it and a silk ribbon tied in her hair, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday dress, not regalia — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of hand-woven linen, silk, cotton and wool, with laced, tied or hooked closures, embroidered hems and soft leather shoes or boots; nothing synthetic, no zips, no printed logos.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body turned three-quarters, her chest angled toward the left of the frame; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the left of the frame; camera low, near the ground — level with her face when she sits, kneels or lies on the floor or a bed, looking up at her when she stands; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small potion bottle of glowing liquid up to the light, looking into it; it is all she holds.
EXPRESSION: soft distant eyes, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a short gold sword in its sheath — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

Avoid: Nothing from our present day in her world: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, headphones, earbuds, sneakers, hoodie, jeans, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, denim, bomber jacket, cowboy hat, sweatpants, leggings, baseball cap, tracksuit, jogger, track pants, windbreaker, fleece, bodycon, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles, sunglasses, bucket hat, beanie, sun visor, acetate.

observations: Raised arm connects naturally to shoulder and holds one potion bottle; far hand out of frame.
